review: The source only changes the SiluAndMul CUDA body to call LightOp on HCU, plus the module-level _use_aiter gate excludes HCU. The existing plugin routes the CUDA body to the same LightOp call with identical output shape/dtype/device and preserves the effective original elsewhere; its constructor AFTER hook switches only a chosen forward_aiter to forward_cuda, retaining deterministic/native selection. Other class/function AST definitions match official.

coverage: actual public LightOp BF16/FP16 forward against FP32 SiLU*up reference across three shapes
Graph replay with changed gate/up inputs

limits: The GPU profile uses the source-compatible default SGLANG_USE_AITER=0. A separate forced-global-AITER=1 attempt fails before activation in fp8_utils because this container lacks aiter.gemm_a8w8_blockscale. The enabling expression and import requirement are also present in the fixed source fork; no fake function, math replacement or source gate modification was introduced. Full global-AITER deployment is not validated.
